***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]

*[[2022 Haitian crisis]]
**The [[United States]] and [[Canada]] send military equipment to [[Haiti]], including tactical and armoured vehicles, as violence and [[shortage]]s continue to worsen in the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/16/us-canada-send-military-aircraft-to-crisis-torn-haiti (Al Jazeera)]
**The U.S. drafts a [[United Nations Security Council resolution|resolution]] at the [[United Nations Security Council]] to approve the deployment of a "multinational rapid action force" to Haiti, citing ongoing "instability and violence" in the country. '''Law and crime'''

**[[Whistleblower]] Will Wilkerson, a co-founder of [[Trump Media & Technology Group]], alleges that the firm violated [[Law of the United States#Federal law|federal]] [[United States securities regulation|securities laws]] and that [[Donald Trump]] pressured executives to give shares to his wife [[Melania Trump|Melania]]. '''Sports'''
*[[2022 ICC Men's T20 World Cup]]
**[[Namibia national cricket team|Namibia]] cause a historic upset by defeating former champions [[Sri Lanka national cricket team|Sri Lanka]] by 55 runs in the opening game of the [[ICC Men's T20 World Cup|T20 World Cup]] in [[Australia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sports-africa-australia-sri-lanka-namibia-4a576f09198c5be3cd15a5094ecd5574 (AP)]
*[[2022 K League 1]]
**[[Ulsan Hyundai FC|Ulsan Horangi]] wins the [[K League 1|K-League]] title for the third time. It is the team's first title since 2005. [https://apnews.com/article/soccer-sports-seoul-international-south-korea-dd12772c50edc0a74f866c6d07eb3987 (AP)]
*[[Devin Haney vs. George Kambosos Jr II]]
**[[Devin Haney]] beats [[George Kambosos Jr.]] via a 12-round [[unanimous decision]] to retain the [[WBA (Super)]], [[World Boxing Council|WBC]], [[IBF]], [[WBO]], and ''[[The Ring (magazine)|The Ring]]'' lightweight titles. [https://apnews.com/article/sports-boxing-australia-melbourne-005dd246d40d00a157df5db1d180642f (AP)]
